urls.title: Pricing page URLs
urls.description: Public HTTP(S) pricing pages to check. Redirects must also stay public.

previousSnapshots.title: Previous snapshots
previousSnapshots.description: Optional baselines keyed by the exact input URL. Each value accepts contentHash and/or pricingText; provided baselines override stored snapshots.

keywords.title: Additional keywords
keywords.description: Case-insensitive text to monitor alongside prices and plan names. Keep these consistent between runs.
